description: Restore MySQL hosts from XtraBackup, Mydumper, and Binlog backups.

fields.description: Populates Backup Source and the Mydumper target database, and is where a Mydumper restore loads. XtraBackup and Binlog only record the name, so a typed one works.
fields.label: Destination Database Service
fields.name: service_id

requires.message: Destination Database Service is required for a Mydumper restore.

fields.description: Restore method for this task; it has to match how the backup was taken, and it selects which sections below apply
fields.label: Backup Type
fields.name: backup_type

fields.description: Pick a service above to list its backups, or type a path: /backups/mydumper/20240101, db01:/path, s3://bucket/path or gs://bucket/path. Add /latest for the most recent.
fields.label: Backup Source
fields.name: backup_source

fields.description: How the backup above is reached. Selecting a transport reveals only the credentials that transport uses.
fields.label: Backup location
fields.name: source_transport

fields.description: Which encryption the backup being restored was written with. The GPG formats reveal the password file used to decrypt it; the AES-256 formats reveal the key file.
fields.label: Backup encryption
fields.name: source_encryption

fields.description: Database the backup is loaded into. Leave empty to restore into the backup's own databases. A typed name is ignored — same as leaving it empty.
fields.label: Target database
fields.name: schema_id

fields.description: Staging directory on the target host where the backup is assembled before it is loaded; the staging copy is removed once the load succeeds, and left behind after a failure (defaults to /tmp)
fields.label: Local path
fields.name: local_path

fields.description: Let the load replace tables that already exist in the target database. Without it the load fails on the first table that is already there.
fields.destructive: Existing tables in the target database are dropped before the backup is loaded. Rows written since the backup was taken are lost.
fields.label: Overwrite tables
fields.name: overwrite_tables

fields.description: How many tables are loaded in parallel. With Overwrite tables on a database whose tables reference each other by foreign key, use 1: replacing those tables in parallel can deadlock
fields.label: Myloader threads
fields.name: myloader_threads

fields.description: Extra arguments appended to the myloader command
fields.label: Myloader extra args
fields.name: myloader_extra_args

fields.description: Databases to leave out of the restore, comma-separated. They are filtered out as the backup is fetched, by file name, and are ignored for a Google Cloud Storage source.
fields.label: Skip databases
fields.name: skip_databases

fields.description: Databases to restore, comma-separated, ignoring the rest of the backup. Filtered as the backup is fetched, by file name, and ignored for a Google Cloud Storage source.
fields.label: Include databases
fields.name: include_databases

fields.description: Path on the target host to a script run before the load. A .sql file is executed against the target MySQL; anything else runs as a command.
fields.label: Pre-script
fields.name: pre_script

fields.description: Path on the target host to a script run after the load. A .sql file is executed against the target MySQL; anything else runs as a command.
fields.label: Post-script
fields.name: post_script

fields.description: Restore only the base backup and ignore the incrementals chained to it
fields.label: Skip incrementals
fields.name: skip_incrementals

fields.description: MySQL data directory the backup is restored into. Required: it has to exist already, and everything currently in it is deleted.
fields.destructive: The data directory is emptied before the backup is restored into it. Whatever it holds now, including a live dataset, is lost.
fields.label: Data directory
fields.name: datadir

fields.description: Memory the prepare step may use, as a size such as 2G (defaults to 100M)
fields.label: XtraBackup prepare memory
fields.name: xb_prepare_memory

fields.description: How many files are decrypted and decompressed in parallel (defaults to 4). Clearing it leaves the decompression unbounded.
fields.label: XtraBackup parallel
fields.name: xb_parallel

fields.description: Which binary prepares the backup; pick the one matching the tool that took it
fields.label: XtraBackup binary
fields.name: xtrabackup_bin_cmd

fields.description: Restore the MySQL configuration files saved in the backup before preparing it, rewriting server id to a fresh value. Choosing one that is not already taken queries the replication source below.
fields.destructive: Each configuration file saved in the backup is written over the live file at its original path, outside the data directory. No copy of what those files held is kept, so hand-tuned settings are lost.
fields.label: Restore my.cnf
fields.name: restore_mycnf

fields.description: Directory where an incremental chain is assembled before it is prepared (defaults to /tmp/pxb_incrementals)
fields.label: Incremental destination path
fields.name: incremental_dest_path

fields.description: Extra arguments appended to the prepare command
fields.label: XtraBackup restore args
fields.name: xtrabackup_restore_args

fields.description: Keyring file the prepare needs for a backup with encrypted tablespaces; read only when the backup binary above is xtrabackup. Falls back to a path found in the configuration files stored inside the backup when left empty.
fields.label: Keyring file data
fields.name: keyring_file_data

fields.description: Start replication once the restore finishes, using the coordinates saved in the backup
fields.label: Slave from master
fields.name: slave_from_master

fields.description: Wait for the restored replica to catch up and fail the task if it does not. Needs replication to be started above.
fields.label: Wait for catchup
fields.name: wait_for_catchup

fields.description: Replication source the restored instance connects to. Used when replication is started above.
fields.label: Master IP
fields.name: master_ip

fields.description: Port used to query the replication source for an unused server id when 'Restore my.cnf' is set. Starting replication itself uses the port in the coordinates saved in the backup.
fields.label: Master port
fields.name: master_port

fields.description: Account the restored instance replicates with
fields.label: Master user
fields.name: master_user

fields.description: Password for the replication account
fields.label: Master password
fields.name: master_password

fields.description: First binlog file to replay
fields.label: Start file
fields.name: start_file

fields.description: Position in the first file to start replaying from
fields.label: Start position
fields.name: start_position

fields.description: Last binlog file to replay
fields.label: Stop file
fields.name: stop_file

fields.description: Position in the last file to stop replaying at
fields.label: Stop position
fields.name: stop_position

fields.description: Dump the binlog range to restore.sql in the staging directory first and then apply that file, instead of piping the binlogs straight into MySQL
fields.label: Use SQL file
fields.name: use_sql_file

fields.description: Extra arguments appended to the mysqlbinlog replay command
fields.label: Binlog restore extra args
fields.name: binlog_restore_extra_args

fields.description: Directory on the target host for this restore's log files
fields.label: Logging directory
fields.name: logging_dir

fields.description: Port PMM Extensions connects to on the target host when it queries the server during an XtraBackup restore (defaults to 3306). A Mydumper restore loads over the destination service's own address and a Binlog restore replays through a local client, so neither uses it.
fields.label: Port
fields.name: port

fields.description: Service command used to stop and start MySQL during an XtraBackup restore, such as /usr/bin/systemctl; detected automatically when left empty. Mydumper and Binlog restores never stop MySQL, so they ignore it.
fields.label: Custom MySQL init command
fields.name: custom_mysql_init_command

fields.description: SSH user for fetching a backup stored on a remote host. Defaults to percona when left blank.
fields.label: SSH user
fields.name: ssh_user

fields.description: SSH port for fetching a backup stored on a remote host. Defaults to 22 when left blank.
fields.label: SSH port
fields.name: ssh_port

fields.description: Unused for the sources above: a local path, remote host, S3 or Google Cloud Storage fetch always authenticates with the SSH user's own id_rsa key.
fields.label: SSH key name
fields.name: ssh_key

fields.description: Client used to download the backup. Defaults to s3cmd when left blank.
fields.label: S3 tool
fields.name: s3_tool

fields.description: Path on the target host to the file holding the passphrase for a GPG-encrypted backup
fields.label: GPG password file
fields.name: gpg_password_file

fields.description: Path on the target host to the AES-256 key file the backup was encrypted with, needed to decrypt .xbcrypt files before restore

forbidden.message: 'xtrabackup_aes256_keyfile' must not be set when 'source_encryption' does not include AES-256.

fields.label: AES-256 key file
fields.name: xtrabackup_aes256_keyfile

name: mysql_backups_restores
